items.description: A reusable classification of slot shape/kind with a role and a default capacity envelope.

name.description: The type's name. PalletRack, Shelf, ToteWall, BulkFloor, Staging and Amnesty are the fleet's established vocabulary, but any name is accepted.

role.description: What a location on the map is FOR (ADR-0016). Storage is the default and only role that existed before this ADR; the rest cover non-storage functional locations that previously had no place on the map at all.

allOf.description: A capacity envelope as it appears on a READ model. Identical to Capacity except that both dimensions may be 0: a LocationType (and a slot of that type) whose role does not require capacity — Dock, Yard, WorkCenter, QC, Shipping — legitimately reports 0/0, the service's way of saying "this location holds nothing by design". Requests still use Capacity, whose dimensions are strictly positive wherever a capacity is supplied at all.

defaultCapacity.description: Required for a role whose RequiresCapacity() is true (Storage, Staging, Drop, Consolidation). Reported as 0/0 for Dock, Yard, WorkCenter, QC, Shipping, which need no capacity envelope.
